title: Social media content in Ecuador | APO Agency
description: Social media content in Ecuador: Instagram carousels from {carruseles} and launch videos from {video}. Get your quote on WhatsApp.
intro: I make Instagram carousels and videos for social media that explain your business clearly and are made to be shared. If you need social media content in Ecuador, I work with you from {ciudad} on a few well-made pieces with one hook, instead of lots of loose content. Here is what each format includes and what it costs.

p: Each piece starts from a clear idea and a goal: to be remembered, to get you messaged or to be shared. I work with your brand and your tone.
ul: Instagram carousels: a cover with a single idea, a second hook, one idea per slide and a closing with a single action.
Launch videos: vertical pieces for Reels and TikTok, designed to show your product, your website or your promotion.
Copy, the order of the ideas and design with your brand identity.
Delivery in formats ready to publish.

secciones.h2: Instagram carousels that get saved and shared
p: A good carousel has a cover that stops the scroll, slides that are easy to read on a phone and a last slide with a single action, for example messaging you on WhatsApp. I make sure each slide reads on a small screen and that there is no excess text. Any data used in the pieces must have a real source: I do not state figures without backing.

secciones.h2: Videos for social media and launch videos
p: Videos for social media work when they show something concrete. A launch video presents your website, your product or a promotion in a few seconds, with your logo and a clear invitation to act. They work for your social media and also as creative for Meta Ads campaigns.

ul: Businesses that want to publish with a clear line instead of improvising.
Brands launching a website, a product or a promotion.
Companies that already run ads and need new pieces.

secciones.h2: How much social media content costs
p: Reference prices in US dollars; the final proposal depends on the scope.
ul: Monthly plan (12 posts and 4 reels): from {plan}/month.

p: We start with a free diagnostic of 30 to 45 minutes. Then I send you a proposal with deliverables and a fixed price. Before producing, I show you the script of each piece for your approval; then I prepare the design and deliver the files. In the monthly plan we measure which pieces work and adjust.

secciones.h2: How we measure whether content works
p: Each piece has a goal, and that goal is measured: saves and shares on a carousel, full views on a video, messages and clicks to your website or your WhatsApp. In the monthly plan we review which pieces worked best and use them as the base for the next ones. That way content stops being a bet and becomes continuous learning for your business.

I need to know what you want to communicate, to whom and with what goal, plus your logo and colors, photos or videos you already have and the data to be shown. If any data is a figure, I need its source: I do not publish numbers that cannot be backed up. And I need you to approve the scripts before production.

The ad spend to boost the pieces is paid separately and managed in the Meta and Google Ads service. On-location video production with a crew and the daily management of your communities are not included either, unless agreed in the proposal.

You work directly with me, approving each piece before it is produced. I make a few well-thought pieces with one hook, keep your visual identity and check that every figure has a source. The price is fixed and the final files are yours.
Content works better alongside a clear website and well-measured campaigns. See real projects where they come together.

faq.q: How much does social media content cost in Ecuador?
faq.a: A pack of 8 carousels, from {carruseles}. A launch video, from {video}. A monthly plan of 12 posts and 4 reels, from {plan}/month.
A post with several swipeable slides. It works well to explain an idea step by step and for people to save and share the content.
A short vertical video for Reels or TikTok that presents your website, your product or a promotion, with your logo and a clear invitation to act.

faq.q: Do I approve the content before it is published?
faq.a: Yes. Before producing each piece I show you the script and you approve it; then I deliver the files ready to publish.

faq.q: Do you publish on my accounts for me?
faq.a: I deliver the pieces ready to publish. If you need help with publishing, we discuss it in the free diagnostic.

faq.q: Do you work with businesses outside {ciudad}?
faq.a: Yes. I work from {ciudad} with businesses all over Ecuador, by video call and WhatsApp.

ctaTexto: Tell me what you want to communicate. I reply within 24 hours with a no-strings proposal.
